strategy.offer: Customized precision wafers, packaging and carrier solutions, interconnect substrates, microfluidic components, and related processing, prototyping, and manufacturing services.
strategy.customers: Industrial customers in electronics, automotive, aerospace, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, medical, and sensor markets, from development projects to direct mass-production supply.
strategy.why_we_win: It combines application-specific design, very high surface precision, tight tolerances, functional integration, and customer collaboration with manufacturing suited for volume production.
strategy.resources: In-house polishing and patterning know-how, long glass and quartz processing experience, certified quality systems, group manufacturing capabilities, and direct plus online sales channels.
strategy.direction: Expand higher-value applications and proprietary products, invest in newer processing technologies and capacity, grow complete systems, and shift simpler standard production to lower-cost manufacturing.
